bio_am: Եըլտըզի 1905-ի մահափորձին մասնակից յեղափոխական Հայուհի, մահացած է Մոնթրէալ՝ 1971-ին։
bio_en: Rubina was one of the women revolutionaries of the Armenian liberation movement, devoted to it from youth. Her name is closely linked with the Yildiz assassination attempt of 21 July 1905 against Sultan Abdul Hamid: when the Sultan left the mosque after the Selamlik ceremony, the bomb in the carriage brought by Rubina and Safo exploded, killing 26 people and wounding 58, though the Sultan escaped. She spent her last years far from her homeland and died in Montreal on 21 April 1971, aged over eighty.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: high. Real name not given in the opening (general knowledge: Rubina Fenerjian, wife of Kris Fenerjian - not used); see also #463 and #487 'Kris Fenerjian'.
